task_title: boardctl doctor subcommand — deep board validation
task_criteria: The boardctl CLI gains a 'doctor' subcommand performing deep validation beyond 'validate': (1) git-tracked-set check on the board directory reports an error/warning if any .db or .parquet file is git-tracked under .coding-hermes/board/ (JSONL-canonical doctrine); (2) header counter sanity: ticks_total/ticks_idle in board.jsonl header cross-checked against the max tick_number present in events.jsonl; (3) fixture orphan detection: fixture ids in fixtures.jsonl that do not appear in tasks.jsonl are reported. Findings render like validate's Report; a board with findings exits non-zero with errors listed; a clean board exits 0. go build ./..., go vet ./..., go test ./... -count=1 -short all pass.
